findings.text: Item 6 omits the required HTTPS-baseUrl case. Reproduction: testConfig({baseUrl:'https://example.test',trustProxy:false}), then makeCookie and makeDeviceCookie with secure=false, produces sessionSecure=false and deviceSecure=false; the required assertion fails. These cookies remain eligible for HTTP transmission. Add this regression test and implement the required Secure behavior, or obtain an explicit scope decision.

Item 8's tampered issuedAt is 219 days in the future, so rejection happens before MAC verification. Reproduction: remove only hasDeviceCookie's MAC comparison in memory and replay the seven cookie vectors; all seven retain their expected results. Thus the new signed fields lack a discriminating forgery test. Change issuedAt within the accepted window without recomputing its MAC, assert no exemption, and prove that removing the MAC check fails that test.
